name: option_chain_snapshot_runs_20261031
comment: ANCHOR: OPTION_CHAIN_SNAPSHOT_RUNS_20261031 — the options chain snapshot writer appends every run to option_chain_snapshot_runs (as_of, slot_et, symbol) beside the unchanged latest-of-day option_chain_snapshots, so the 17:35 ET run no longer erases the 10:00 ET reading; absent table (migration not applied) is reported and the daily table is still written; migration pair idempotent, down renames (never drops). No network, no DB, no broker.
